architecture.system_overview: Multi-page static architecture with persistent Machi cold brew aesthetic. Separation of concerns across landing discovery (index.html), order execution (menu.html), live status tracking (status.html), and dedicated seller operations (penjual.html). Shared state via localStorage and API polling (/api/orders).

index.html.role: Brand landing page for Kantin Boash

menu.html.role: Full ordering catalog and checkout portal

status.html.role: Dedicated live order tracking and queue visualization

penjual.html.role: Dedicated Merchant POS Dashboard with Machi aesthetic

architecture.data_flow: 1. Student browses index.html or menu.html -> 2. Adds items to cart in menu.html (persisted in localStorage: kantin_cart) -> 3. Fills checkout modal in menu.html and submits POST /api/orders -> 4. Receives order ID + queueNumber, sets localStorage: kantin_active_order_id, redirects to status.html?id={orderId} -> 5. status.html polls /api/orders?id={orderId} every 1.5s and updates timeline -> 6. Seller at penjual.html receives incoming order notification (visual card + sound chime) -> 7. Seller advances status via PATCH /api/orders (Dipesan -> Disiapkan -> Siap Diambil -> Selesai) -> 8. status.html updates automatically in real-time.

state_management.cart_sync: localStorage key 'kantin_cart' synced across index.html and menu.html via storage events and load hooks
state_management.order_sync: localStorage key 'kantin_active_order_id' and URL query param 'id' checked on status.html load
state_management.merchant_sync: 1.5s interval polling of /api/orders with local diff detection to trigger sound chime

motion_lifecycle.rule: Strict Motion Cap: Exactly ONE orchestrated moment per page

index.html.orchestrated_moment: hero-floating-cups (subtle CSS floating transform on hero cups, 4s duration, zero layout shift)
index.html.all_other_transitions: Instant or subtle opacity/color hover transitions (<=150ms)

status.html.orchestrated_moment: order-status-timeline (progress bar fill on status advancement)

penjual.html.orchestrated_moment: merchant-dashboard-pos (card entry fade on newly incoming orders)

motion_lifecycle.reduced_motion: prefers-reduced-motion media query completely halts keyframe animations and drawer transitions.

breaking_scenarios.vector: Student adds items to cart in menu.html, navigates to index.html or reloads, and returns to menu.html
breaking_scenarios.expected_defense: Cart state in localStorage ('kantin_cart') automatically hydrates on DOMContentLoaded across both index.html and menu.html. Cart badge counter and items persist without loss or item duplication.

breaking_scenarios.vector: Seller clicks 'Mulai Siapkan' or 'Tandai Siap Diambil' in penjual.html while student is actively viewing status.html
breaking_scenarios.expected_defense: penjual.html performs PATCH /api/orders?id={id}&status={status}. status.html polling loop (1.5s interval) catches updated status, re-renders timeline active step, changes badge color, and updates instructions within 2.0 seconds.

breaking_scenarios.vector: Direct navigation to status.html without query param and without existing order in localStorage, or with non-existent order ID
breaking_scenarios.expected_defense: status.html detects null/invalid order, hides timeline and QR container, and displays friendly empty state ('Tidak Ada Pesanan Aktif') with actionable button 'Buka Daftar Menu' linking to menu.html. Zero JS uncaught exceptions.

breaking_scenarios.vector: API server (/api/orders) unreachable or returns 500 during order placement or status fetching
breaking_scenarios.expected_defense: Fallback to client localStorage mock order store ('kantin_orders'). Generates local order ID, saves order record, and transitions to status page without blocking the student.
CSS media query disables all floating animations and translation transitions, rendering static layout immediately.
